acceptance_criteria.title: Saving a new article as a draft
acceptance_criteria.api: authenticated `draft: true` create is accepted with 201 and `{ article }` carrying `draft: true`; a missing or empty title is refused; description and body may be empty; unauthenticated save is 401 and stores nothing.
acceptance_criteria.web: editor offers save as draft, permits empty description and body for a draft, and shows the saved draft with a visible draft marker and not as published.

acceptance_criteria.title: Draft-save validation
acceptance_criteria.api: a missing or empty title gives 400 with field errors and no stored change; a title with empty description or body is accepted as a draft.
acceptance_criteria.web: title errors are shown; empty description and body do not block a draft save.

acceptance_criteria.title: A draft is private to its Author
acceptance_criteria.api: 404 for every non-Author read, with no draft data; the stored draft is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.web: no draft content is shown; the viewer is redirected or shown a not-found state.

acceptance_criteria.title: Other users cannot mutate a draft
acceptance_criteria.api: 404 for every Other User mutation; 401 for an unauthenticated Visitor write; no stored change and no related record created.
acceptance_criteria.web: no draft page or draft action is available to the Other User or Visitor.

acceptance_criteria.title: Profile shows published articles and a separate drafts list
acceptance_criteria.api: own drafts list returns only the Author's drafts with `draft: true`, most recently edited or saved first, 10 per page with the Author's drafts count; public author list returns only published articles; non-Author drafts-list requests answer 404.
acceptance_criteria.web: own profile has a separate, visibly marked drafts list with the decided order and pagination; other profiles and the public list show no drafts.

acceptance_criteria.title: Reopening and saving a draft
acceptance_criteria.api: author `draft: true` update succeeds with 200 and `{ article }` carrying `draft: true`; content is changed; no published article is created; title coexistence is accepted and the private draft address is kept.
acceptance_criteria.web: draft reopens with stored content; changes are visible after save; the draft marker remains.

acceptance_criteria.title: Publishing a draft
acceptance_criteria.api: the `draft: false` update publishes once with 200 and `{ article }` where `draft` is `false`; only a non-empty title is required, and empty description and body survive into the published article; the address is title-derived with a numeric suffix when taken; the creation date is the publishing moment and the article appears in newest-first lists.
acceptance_criteria.web: article is shown as published, leaves the drafts list and appears in the published/global lists.

acceptance_criteria.title: Publishing a draft whose title is already published is refused
acceptance_criteria.api: 422 with `{ errors: { title: [...] } }` containing a title-taken message; no new publication; draft and existing article unchanged apart from previously saved draft changes.
acceptance_criteria.web: error is shown; the draft remains a marked draft with its content.

acceptance_criteria.title: A published article never becomes a draft
acceptance_criteria.api: 422 with `{ errors: { published: [...] } }`; published article remains published and unchanged; no draft is created.
acceptance_criteria.web: no unpublish control appears for a published article.

acceptance_criteria.title: A draft save racing a publish keeps the article published
acceptance_criteria.api: final state is published; first publishing date is kept; the concurrent draft save receives 422 with `{ errors: { published: [...] } }`; no duplicate publication or address.
acceptance_criteria.web: the published article is displayed without a draft marker and no draft remains.

acceptance_criteria.title: Publishing the same draft twice publishes once
acceptance_criteria.api: one published article with the first publishing date; the second request returns 200 with the already published article.
acceptance_criteria.web: the publish action is unavailable while the first request is in progress; no duplicate entry appears.

acceptance_criteria.title: Deleting a draft removes it without publishing it
acceptance_criteria.api: the delete removes the draft and returns 200 with the deleted article body; later reads answer 404; no published article or public list entry ever exists for it.
acceptance_criteria.web: the draft disappears from the Author's drafts list.

acceptance_criteria.title: Lists, counts and pages ignore drafts
acceptance_criteria.api: every article list and every article count excludes drafts; only the drafts list includes them.
acceptance_criteria.web: global, feed, tag, author-published and favorites lists show no drafts; pagination reflects the published-only counts.

acceptance_criteria.title: Popular tags ignore draft-only tags
acceptance_criteria.api: tag list excludes tags whose only articles are drafts; tag appears after a published article uses it.
acceptance_criteria.web: the popular-tags sidebar shows the same filtered set.

acceptance_criteria.title: Favorites and comments on a draft are refused
acceptance_criteria.api: 404 for any signed-in user including the Author, 401 for an unauthenticated Visitor write; no favorite, comment or count change.
acceptance_criteria.web: the Author's draft page offers neither favorite nor comment actions.

acceptance_criteria.title: Drafts and published articles may share titles
acceptance_criteria.api: creating a published article with a draft's title succeeds and gives it a title-derived address with a suffix when taken; drafts with equal titles are accepted, stay unchanged and keep their private draft addresses; saving a draft with a published title succeeds.
acceptance_criteria.web: both the draft and the published article are shown in their proper places, with the draft marked as a draft.

acceptance_criteria.title: Existing articles remain published and in place
acceptance_criteria.api: existing articles answer as published with unchanged creation dates and ordering; no existing row becomes a draft.
acceptance_criteria.web: existing article pages and lists are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.title: The server enforces every rule
acceptance_criteria.api: every rule is observable through direct requests, including 404 hiding, list/counter exclusion, refused favorites/comments, refused unpublishing, single publication and publish-time dates.
acceptance_criteria.web: not required to be the enforcement point; the page may add presentation only.

acceptance_criteria.title: Save and publish actions cannot be triggered twice from the web
acceptance_criteria.api: duplicate requests that still arrive are handled by the server rules (AC-10, AC-11).
acceptance_criteria.web: the in-progress save or publish control cannot start a second request.

acceptance_criteria.title: Demo data contains exactly one alice draft
acceptance_criteria.api: after repeated seeding, one seeded alice draft with the decided content exists, other alice drafts are untouched, and the draft is absent from public lists/counts/tags and present in alice's drafts list.
acceptance_criteria.web: alice's profile shows the seeded draft in her drafts list; other pages do not show it.

implied_obligations.text: Single-article reads must hide drafts from non-Authors and answer 404 without draft data.
The global article list, author filter, tag filter, favorites filter and their counts must exclude drafts for every caller.
The personal feed list and its count must exclude drafts.
Reading comments for a draft must not reveal the draft.
Creating a comment on a draft must be refused before any comment row is created.
Favoriting and unfavoriting a draft must be refused before the favorite relation is changed.
Updating or deleting a draft must require the requesting user to be its Author and answer 404 otherwise, without changing or removing the draft.
Popular-tag reads must exclude tags that have no published article.

The current article model has no draft/published state, makes `title` globally unique and uses `slug` as the primary key; it must be reconciled so a draft can have a private address and publication assigns a title-derived address with a numeric suffix if taken (decided by Q-12), while still refusing publication on a published title.
Article responses, shared contracts and the web decoder need a `draft: boolean` in every article response so the web can mark drafts and separate the drafts list (decided by Q-2).

Publishing must derive the address from the current title, adding a numeric suffix when that address is already taken (decided by Q-12), and set the creation date at publish time; the existing list order is by creation date newest first.

Draft updates currently rewrite the slug from the old slug rather than the new title, and article creation derives the slug from the title; draft saves must keep the private draft address and publication must assign the title-derived address with a numeric suffix if taken (decided by Q-12).

Article validation must cover draft saves and publication, not only the current publish-shaped create/update requests; a draft save requires a non-empty title while description and body may be empty (decided by Q-4), publication follows the same rule (decided by Q-15, agent decision), and the create validator currently requires all three.

The web profile needs a drafts list next to the published list, visible only on the Author's own profile, ordered most recently edited or saved first (decided by Q-10) and paginated at 10 per page with the Author's drafts count (decided by Q-11); it currently has only "My Articles" and "Favorited Articles" and asks for all articles by the author.

The web editor needs a save-as-draft action that requires only a title and allows empty description and body for a draft (decided by Q-4), and must prevent a second save/publish while one is in progress; it currently offers only "Publish Article", and `GenericForm`'s submit button is not disabled even when the form is submitting.

The article page must mark a draft and expose publication to its Author, while offering no favorite/comment actions on a draft; it currently has only owner Edit/Delete and non-owner favorite/follow/comment controls.

Web services and error decoding must support `draft: boolean` (decided by Q-2), the drafts list, publication, and the 422 title/published field errors (decided by Q-5); the current error decoder expects `{errors: Record<string, string[]>}`.

The seed must upsert exactly one seeded alice draft with the decided content (decided by Q-13) and leave other alice drafts untouched (decided by Q-14), without disturbing the existing published articles, users, tags, comments, follow and favorite records.
Existing rows and the migration must treat every pre-feature article as published with its current creation date and list position.

A publication title conflict must reach the Author as a 422 title field error (decided by Q-5); the current Prisma error handler answers `{errors: string[]}`, which the web's `GenericErrorBody` decoder does not accept.
The existing end-to-end expectation that the global feed shows exactly the three seeded published articles and the `typescript` tag must keep holding with the seeded draft present.
Reading a drafts list is available to any caller but returns 404 to non-Authors (decided by Q-3), while draft writing and publication require a signed-in user and anonymous writes must stay 401.

The article update and delete controllers do not compare the current user with the article author today; draft protection must add that comparison for drafts without changing unrelated published-article behavior.
